# `add price` treats prices generated by `implicit_prices` as ledger-written

**Severity: minor. Owner: cli. Estimate: ~20m. A1:** duplicate/conflict reports must point at real ledger lines. Continuous CLI QA, 2026-10-03 (round 9); report and filing only, no fix applied.

Environment: `main` HEAD `97dab6b0`, checkout `cli/.venv/bin/bea` 0.3.1, Python 3.13, macOS 26.5.1 arm64. Fresh process per command with timeouts, isolated `HOME`/`BEA_CONFIG_DIR`/`XDG_CACHE_HOME`, notifier disabled, no inherited `BEA_FILE`/`BEA_TOKEN`/`CI`, synthetic fixtures, stdin closed. Reproduced twice with a working control.

Header `B`: `option "operating_currency" "USD"`, `2020-01-01 open Assets:Cash USD`, `2020-01-01 open Expenses:Food USD`.

Add `plugin "beancount.plugins.implicit_prices"`, `open Assets:Broker HOOL`, and `2020-03-01 * "buy"` with `Assets:Broker 1 HOOL @ 100 USD` / `Assets:Cash`.

```sh
bea --json --file /abs/ip.bean add price --date 2020-03-01 -c HOOL --amount '100 USD'    # duplicate: true, source = the transaction's line
bea --json --file /abs/ip.bean add price --date 2020-03-01 -c HOOL --amount '101 USD'    # exit 2: already has a 2020-03-01 price of 100 USD (at ip.bean:10)
```

Expected: help — reports "an exact ledger-authored … match"; `w1/done/m23/t007` classes plugin-made prices as generated.

Cause: `cli/src/bea_engine/ledger/adding.py:390–403` excludes only managed-feed filenames; plugin prices carry the source transaction's filename/lineno.

Fix/acceptance: skip generated entries (the reader's `entry_generated`) when matching. Both commands write the price (or conflict only with a written price directive).

Dedupe: `w3/done/318` (list) and `m23/t007` (list/query) don't cover `add`.

---

**Resolved 2026-10-03** — `add price` now ignores prices generated by plugins such as `implicit_prices`, so only written price directives count as duplicates or conflicts. A test in `tests/test_add_idempotency.py` covers it. Shipped in the commit that moved this note (`cli`).
